subject: Probability Assignment 3
body:
Dear students,

Assignment 3 for Probability and Statistics is now on the course portal. It covers conditional probability and Bayes' theorem. The assignment is due Friday 23 October, 11:59 PM. Late submissions will lose 10% per day.

Regards,
Prof. S. Rao

subject: Correction: Probability Assignment 3 deadline
body:
Dear students,

A correction to my earlier email: because of the department holiday on Friday, the deadline for Assignment 3 has moved earlier. Please submit Probability Assignment 3 by Thursday 22 October, 11:59 PM instead.

Sorry for the confusion.
Prof. S. Rao

subject: Lab 5 report due Thursday
body:
Hello everyone,

This is a reminder that the Lab 5 report is due this Thursday by 5 PM. Upload a single PDF on the lab portal. Reports without the observation table will not be graded.

Ms. Iyer

subject: Updated lab instructions for Lab 5
body:
Hello everyone,

I have updated the instruction sheet for Lab 5. Question 3 now asks you to plot the results with matplotlib instead of Excel. The revised PDF is on the portal. No change to the submission process.

Ms. Iyer

subject: Project review meeting
body:
Hi team,

Let's have our project review meeting this Wednesday at 4 PM in Lab 3. Please bring your progress notes and be ready to demo the current build.

Dr. Menon

subject: Re: Project review meeting - rescheduled
body:
Hi team,

I have a conflict on Wednesday, so the project review meeting is rescheduled to Thursday at 11 AM. Same room, Lab 3. Sorry for the short notice.

Dr. Menon

subject: Workshop planning meeting
body:
Hey core team,

We need to finalise the speaker list and the schedule for the CTF workshop. Planning meeting is on Saturday, 24 October at 10:00 AM in the club room. Everyone should attend.

- EHaCS

subject: Campus Weekly: Diwali fest, photography club and more
body:
This week on campus!

* Diwali fest stalls open from 28 October near the main lawn.
* The photography club is showing its annual exhibition in the library hall.
* Cafeteria now serves filter coffee until 6 PM.

Want to be featured? Write to us anytime. Unsubscribe at the bottom of this email.

subject: Summer internship applications open
body:
Dear students,

The placement cell has opened summer internship applications for second- and third-year students. Applications close on 2 November. Fill the form on the placement portal and attach your latest resume.

Placement Cell

subject: Mid-semester examination timetable
body:
Dear students,

The mid-semester examination timetable has been released. Data Structures exam: 9 November, 10:00 AM, Room LH-2. Carry your ID card. The full timetable is on the notice board and the portal.

Examination Section

subject: Slides for the Friday presentation
body: Hey! Can you send me your part of the slides by tomorrow 6 PM? I'm merging everything into one deck tomorrow night. Keep it to 4 slides max. Thanks!

subject: Book return reminder
body:
Dear member,

The book 'Introduction to Algorithms' issued to you is due soon. Please return it by 25 October to avoid a fine of Rs. 5 per day.

Central Library

subject: Mess menu change this week
body:
Hi all,

Due to supply issues the Thursday dinner menu changes to khichdi and papad. Sunday breakfast stays the same. Thank you for understanding.

Mess Committee

subject: 50% off Premium - this weekend only!
body: Level up your interview prep! Get 50% off CodeArena Premium this weekend only. Unlock 500+ company-wise problems and mock interviews. Use code SLOTH50 at checkout. Offer ends Sunday midnight.

subject: Quiz in Python lab
body:
Hello students,

There will be a short quiz on functions and file handling at the start of class on Monday at 9:00 AM. It is closed book and carries 5 marks.

Prof. Mehta

subject: Fee payment reminder - odd semester
body:
Dear student,

This is a reminder to pay the remaining odd semester fee. The last date for payment without a late fine is 30 October 2026. Pay online through the student portal and keep the receipt.

Accounts Office

subject: Scholarship verification form
body:
Hello,

Please submit the scholarship verification form to the welfare office soon. We will close the verification list once we have enough responses. Bring a printed copy.

Student Welfare Office

subject: Lab 5 viva slots
body:
Hello everyone,

Viva slots for Lab 5 are Monday morning or Monday afternoon. Please reply to this email with your preferred slot by Friday. Slots are first come, first served.

Ms. Iyer
